Marsriva KP4 10000mAh – Mini Smart DC UPS

Marsriva KP4 10000mAh Mini Smart DC UPS is the ideal power backup solution for your Wi-Fi router, modem, or CCTV camera. Featuring a high-capacity 10000mAh lithium-ion battery, this mini smart UPS ensures uninterrupted power supply during outages. With a maximum output of 18W and multiple output ports, including DC and USB, the Marsriva KP4 keeps your devices running smoothly. The 0ms AC-to-DC transfer ensures no downtime, while the compact design and wall-mount options provide flexible installation. Perfect for home or office use, this UPS guarantees continuous connectivity and reliable power backup. Stay connected and secure with the Marsriva KP4 10000mAh Mini Smart DC UPS – your ultimate power solution.
